limitations: No raw force, pressure, position, mesh, log or result payload is read.
No force-balance, damping-force, geometry-intersection or continuous-trajectory calculator is implemented.
Classification label consistency is not actual source authentication or physical defect closure.
Counts and hashes alone never certify a physical state or equal-pressure comparison.
A coherent replacement of plan, context and metadata is not blocked by an external trust anchor.
Fixed qualification-matrix pin is a declared source reference; it does not import actual qualification or execution authority.

The original preparation interruption stderr is present only in the tool transcript, not as a preserved raw stderr file.
Actual-value access flags describe this DEMP subtask/invocations only, not every message in the parent conversation.
